title: Codul educației al Republicii Moldova
in_force_basis: LP191 din 21.07.17, MO301-315/18.08.17 art.539; în vigoare 18.08.17; newest amendment in force by the archive capture of 2017-11-01
note: Consolidated text of the old State Register of Legal Acts (lex.justice.md, Ministry of Justice), read from the Internet Archive copy named in source. lex.justice.md was replaced by legis.md in 2019 and its last updates date from early 2019; later amendments are not in this record.
